title: Omnisolver: An extensible interface to Ising spin-glass and QUBO solvers: adding a distributed GPU brute-force plugin
summary: This software update extends Omnisolver with \texttt{omnisolver-bruteforce}, a first-class plugin for exact exhaustive search of QUBO and Ising instances on CUDA-enabled GPUs. The update contributes three components: packaging of the single-GPU brute-force kernel of [Computer Physics Communications 260, 107728, 2021] as a first-class Omnisolver plugin with a uniform Python and CLI interface, a Ray-based distributed framework that splits the search into $2^{k}$ fixed-variable subproblems and dispatches them across multiple GPUs and hosts, with a controller that gathers and merges partial…
